critical_code_review_comments: server.py is now ~923 lines (exceeds 700 threshold) — strongly recommend splitting into routers/{auth,jobs,companies,files,public,payments,invoice}.py before adding more features.

POST /api/companies/me/logo returns only {"path": ...} while PATCH /companies/me returns full company doc — inconsistent shape. Consider returning the full company doc from logo upload too (UI currently re-fetches via /companies/me).

Invoice PDF is served same-origin via httpOnly cookie — anchor target=_blank works in Chrome/Edge/Firefox; Safari ITP may not send cookies on top-level navigation to subdomain in some configurations. Consider a short-lived signed URL or token query param fallback (same pattern as /api/files).

BrandingIn currently only accepts primary_color & accent_color — logo_path is set server-side via the upload endpoint (good), but consider validating hex format with a regex (^#[0-9A-Fa-f]{6}$) to avoid bad CSS values being persisted.
PDF endpoint loads reportlab on every request — fine for low volume, but if usage grows, cache styled fonts/canvases or generate async.
